name: CI/CD Pipeline Engine
description: CI/CD pipeline orchestration represents the highest-privilege automated process in the delivery chain, capable of compiling code, executing arbitrary commands, building container images, promoting artifacts, and triggering deployments. Misconfigurations in pipeline definitions, runner permissions, secrets handling, and dependency resolution create pathways for supply chain compromise, lateral movement into production environments, and credential theft. The combination of broad network access, elevated runtime permissions, and access to production secrets makes this component a critical attack surface.
